subject: 20 apprentices from February - data and AI
summary: Castlegate Rail Services (new prospect, 1,800 staff, levy payer) wants 20 Data Analyst and AI apprentices from February 2027.

messages.body:
Hello,

I'm Head of Early Careers at Castlegate Rail Services. We're a rail maintenance and infrastructure business with around 1,800 staff across the Midlands and the North, and we pay the levy (roughly £410k a year, and a good chunk of it is due to expire over the next few months).

We'd like to put **20 colleagues** on apprenticeships starting in February 2027, roughly:

- 12 x Data Analyst (Level 4) - mostly from our asset performance and planning teams
- 8 x something AI-focused for our engineering supervisors - I saw your Level 4 AI & Automation Practitioner launch on LinkedIn

We're talking to two other providers and want to make a decision before Christmas. Could someone senior call me this week? I'm free most of Thursday and Friday morning.

Many thanks,

Priya Venkatesh
Head of Early Careers, Castlegate Rail Services
07700 900 418

triage.action: Hot lead: Senior Client Partner to call Priya this week, log the opportunity in PipelineHQ (source Inbound web, ~20 starts, Levy) and send the AI4/DA4 programme specifications.
triage.notes: New employer, 20 learners, levy payer, competing providers and a pre-Christmas decision - meets the hot-lead rule (10+ learners or levy payer with a deadline).

subject: Media enquiry - AI apprenticeships feature (deadline Thurs 12:00)

messages.body:

I'm writing a feature for FE Insight Weekly on how training providers are responding to employer demand for AI skills, and whether providers are "practising what they preach" by using AI internally.

I understand Delcorn has launched a Level 4 AI & Automation Practitioner programme and is rolling out Copilot to all staff. Could someone give me 2-3 sentences of comment, ideally from your CEO, on:

Best,
Hannah Lowther
Senior Reporter, FE Insight Weekly
020 7946 0812

subject: Formal complaint - apprentice review cancelled twice

messages.body:
To whom it may concern,

I wish to make a formal complaint. One of our apprentices, Stanley Perry (DevOps Engineering), was due a progress review at the end of October. It was cancelled on the morning by your coach, rebooked, and then cancelled again on 29 October. Nobody has been in touch since.

His store manager has rearranged rotas twice to free him up for these reviews. Stanley is now worried he is "behind" and frankly so am I - we were told his hours are well short and there is no plan to fix it.

I'd like a named contact, an explanation and a date for the review.

Allan Barnes
Apprenticeship Lead, Sharp Stores plc

triage.action: Log as a Stage 1 formal complaint; Quality Manager to acknowledge within 3 working days and assign an investigating manager, and ask the Delivery Manager (Sam Patel) to book Stanley's review urgently.
triage.sla: Acknowledge within 3 working days; respond within 15 working days
triage.notes: Learner LRN21414 Stanley Perry, DO4, Red RAG, review overdue (due 29 Oct 2026), OTJ well behind plan. Do not reply defensively from the shared mailbox.

subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Ledgerline password expires in 24 hours
summary: Phishing email impersonating Ledgerline, asking users to 'verify' their password via a link.

messages.body:
Dear Ledgerline user,

Our records show your Ledgerline password will **expire in 24 hours**. To avoid interruption to payment runs and approvals, please verify your credentials now:

VERIFY MY ACCOUNT >> hxxps://ledgerline-secure-login.com/delcorn/verify

If you do not verify, your account will be suspended and pending payments may be cancelled.

Thank you,
Ledgerline Account Security Team

This is an automated message. Please do not reply.

triage.action: Do not click or reply. Report with the Outlook Report button and raise a FixDesk P1 security ticket for the IT Service Desk Lead (Mohammed Ali); the Information Security Officer checks whether anyone clicked.
triage.notes: Tells: lookalike domain (not Ledgerline's own), urgency and threats, generic greeting. Delcorn has no forced password expiry, and Ledgerline uses Microsoft 365 sign-in.

triage.notes: Learner LRN21727, TL3, status Gateway, past planned end date - risk to timely achievement.

subject: Extra time for my assessment?
summary: An apprentice with additional learning support asks about extra time and assistive software for a project assessment.

messages.body:
Hi,

I have dyslexia and I get additional support on my AI & Automation Practitioner programme. I've got a big written project coming up and wondered if I can have extra time and use read-aloud software. Who do I need to speak to?

Thanks
Sarah (LRN20382)

triage.action: Learner Support Lead to review Sarah's ALS plan with coach Abbie Edwards and confirm reasonable adjustments (extra time, assistive technology).
triage.notes: Learner LRN20382, AI4, ALS in place. EPA adjustments must also be requested from the EPAO in advance.

subject: Leaving my job - what happens to my apprenticeship?
summary: An apprentice says he has resigned and asks whether he can continue his apprenticeship.

messages.body:
Hi,

I've handed in my notice at Watson Insurance - my last day is 20 November. I'm starting a new job at a smaller company in December. Can I carry on with my apprenticeship there or do I lose everything I've done?

Roy Green (Working Smarter with AI)

triage.action: Delivery Manager (AI & Data) to call Roy about transferring to the new employer (or a break in learning) before his leaving date, and inform the Funding & MI Analyst for the ILR.
triage.notes: Learner LRN21391, AI3, Red RAG. 'Left employer' is the top withdrawal reason - a transfer conversation now may save the learner.

subject: What counts as off-the-job?
summary: A Sharp Stores line manager asks what counts as off-the-job training for his apprentice.

messages.body:
Hi,

Mitchell Ali is on your Data Analyst apprenticeship and works in my team. Does shadowing our BI team count as off-the-job? And does it have to be a full day a week or can it be split up?

Neil
Head of Merchandising Analytics, Sharp Stores plc

triage.action: Reply with 'Off-the-Job Training: A Guide for Employers' and confirm the coach (Donald Moore) will cover it at the next review.
triage.notes: Learner LRN20814, DA4. Standard query - suitable for a templated reply.

subject: Maths exam date
summary: A 16-18 apprentice asks when his Functional Skills maths exam will be.

messages.body:
Hiya, when is my functional skills maths exam? my tutor said november but i havent got a date yet. also can i do it online?

Christian LRN21154

triage.action: Functional Skills Tutor to confirm the exam booking and whether remote invigilation is available.
triage.notes: Learner LRN21154, AI3, aged 16-18.

subject: Automatic reply: Progress review - Marcus Booth
summary: Out-of-office reply from an apprentice's line manager.

messages.body:
I'm on annual leave returning Tuesday 10 November. For anything urgent about early careers, please contact earlycareers@brightwellfoods.co.uk.

Timothy Young
Talent Development Manager, Brightwell Foods Ltd

triage.action: No reply; note the return date for the coach arranging Marcus Booth's review.

subject: RE: Can't log in to Aptiva - activation link expired
summary: The same new apprentice chases his Aptiva access ahead of his first review.

messages.body:
Hi again,

Just following up on my email from last week - I still can't get into Aptiva and my first review is on Thursday. My coach says I need to upload evidence before then.

Thanks,
Elliot

triage.action: Link to the existing FixDesk ticket from inb-ls-02 (do not raise a second one), escalate it, and reply to Elliot today.
triage.notes: Duplicate of inb-ls-02; priority raised because his review is on 5 November.

subject: Subject access request
summary: A former apprentice makes a subject access request for all personal data Delcorn holds about her.

messages.body:
Dear Delcorn,

Under the UK GDPR I am making a subject access request. I was an apprentice on your People Professional programme until I withdrew earlier this year.

Please provide a copy of all personal data you hold about me, including my Aptiva records, my coach's notes and any emails or Teams messages that mention me.

I look forward to your response within one month.

Natalie Fenwick-Shaw

triage.action: Forward to the Data Protection Officer (dpo@delcorn.co.uk) the same day; do not reply with any data. The DPO logs and acknowledges it and must respond by 30 November 2026.
triage.notes: Statutory deadline runs from receipt (30 October 2026). Includes emails, Teams chats and Copilot-generated documents.

subject: invoice DLC-CI-2610-007 - bank details?
summary: An employer's finance contact asks Learner Support how to pay a co-investment invoice.

messages.body:
Hi,

We've had invoice DLC-CI-2610-007 for £1,750 for our two apprentices but the PDF doesn't seem to show your bank details. Can you send them?

Mohammad French
HR Business Partner, Ahmed Consulting

triage.action: Forward to accounts@delcorn.co.uk; the Management Accountant replies from Accounts, giving bank details only in the standard invoice format or by phone, never in an ad hoc email.
triage.notes: Belongs in the Accounts mailbox.

subject: Judith Ward - worried about her
summary: Judith Ward's depot manager reports she has not been at work or answered calls for eight days, which is out of character.

messages.body:
Hi,

Sorry to email the general address. Judith Ward (Data Analyst apprentice) hasn't been at work since 27 October and isn't answering calls or messages from me or the team. That isn't like her at all. HR are following our absence process, but I wondered if she's been in touch with her coach or with you? Just want to know she's OK.

Darren Pike
Depot Manager, Kestrel Logistics UK

triage.action: Pass to the Deputy DSL (Megan Taylor) the same day for a welfare check; the safeguarding team contacts Judith and her coach, and decides what to share with the employer.
triage.notes: Learner LRN20492, DA4, Red RAG. Unexplained absence and no contact is a welfare concern - don't confirm or share any information about the learner until the safeguarding team has reviewed. Linked to inb-acc-13.

subject: ALS referral form?
summary: A skills coach asks for the current additional learning support referral form.

messages.body:
Hi Megan / team,

One of my DA4 learners has just told me she thinks she has ADHD and is struggling with the written assignments. Where's the latest ALS referral form? The link in the handbook goes to an old version.

Thanks,
James

triage.action: Learner Support Lead to send the current ALS referral form and fix the broken link in the Skills Coach Handbook.

subject: Fourth coach in a year - not happy
summary: An apprentice complains that her coach has changed four times and she has had to repeat work.

messages.body:
Hello,

I'm on the Team Leader apprenticeship and I've just been told I'm getting a new coach - that's my fourth in twelve months. Each time I have to explain my job again and I've had to redo evidence because the new coach wanted it done differently. I'd like to make a complaint. I don't feel anyone is looking out for my progress.

Molly Wilson
Orbis Telecom

triage.action: Log as a Stage 1 complaint; Quality Manager acknowledges within 3 working days and assigns an investigating manager (Delivery Manager, Leadership & People).
triage.sla: Acknowledge within 3 working days; respond within 15 working days
triage.notes: Learner LRN20720, TL3. The learner explicitly says she wants to complain.

subject: Workshop clash 12 Nov
summary: The same apprentice who emailed Enquiries asks Learner Support to move his workshop.

messages.body:
Hi, sent this to the wrong address yesterday I think. I need to move off the 12 Nov Leading Hybrid Teams workshop as I'm on site. Any later date is fine.

Phil (LRN21760)

triage.action: Rebook onto the next available workshop and reply once; close the Enquiries copy (inb-enq-17).
triage.notes: Duplicate of inb-enq-17.

subject: Observation on 3 Nov - feedback for Donna?
summary: Pennant Combined Authority's line manager asks for feedback from a coach's workplace observation of their apprentice.

messages.body:
Hello,

Fatima from your team came to observe Donna Nolan (AI & Automation Practitioner) on Tuesday. Donna found it really useful. Is there a written summary we can have for Donna's development file?

Thanks,
Charles Parsons
Early Careers Manager, Pennant Combined Authority

triage.action: Ask the coach (Fatima Hussain) to share a typed summary of her observation notes via Aptiva and reply to Charles.
triage.notes: Learner LRN21443, AI4. Notes are handwritten (see the scanned observation notes).
